items: Forts and capitals can rebuild torn-down walls, and capitals always offer Rebuild walls. Roads can cross a wall between two of your own provinces. Fixed walls showing two health bars.
Lakes and the ocean come out of the fog once every province on their shores is explored.
Ranged soldiers take 80% less damage in the back row.
Wars can take you over your province limit. Each extra province costs 5 gold, 5 wood and 5 food upkeep, and a flag warns you.

New Proclaim Enemy action (âˆ’300 opinion). Computer nations proclaim enemies too, and a shared enemy gives +50. Military access and Trade Networks give +25 opinion. The Diplomacy page shows each nationâ€™s opinion of you and its enemy. Only computer nations are limited to one ally. No flirting with Swamplings; a Swampling growl at another race is always âˆ’25. Gifted gold always arrives.
Outposts, forts and capitals can be developed up to level 3 for more resources and houses; in forts and capitals each level also raises the province limit. Occupation resets it.
A Build Outpost button on unclaimed provinces. Ogre Caves sit against the mountains and can be ordered from the Armies tab.
Hisola and Taal start with 4 Riders / Ogres and a Stable / Ogre Cave with no upkeep; their cavalry and Ogres cost 3 food, and their capital province gives 7 more food.
New Army Training Order tab: order a whole army from every Barracks and have it gather in one province.
